name: Afghanistan
description: A white field bearing the shahada in black Thuluth calligraphy across the centre.
history: The flag of the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan: the Taliban's plain white banner had the shahada added on 27 October 1997 and flew until the fall of Kabul on 12 November 2001. The movement kept it through the insurgency and raised it again over the capital on 15 August 2021, when the black-red-green tricolour was banned; it has served as the flag of Afghanistan de facto since, without a published flag law.

features.symbolism: purity of faith and of the Islamic Emirate
